answer: Proposed gate: one listing per ID/day requires a lab-signed transmission test of violet pigment on quartz and an ID/day-bound delay proof of 10^8 sequential squarings from fresh validator randomness. Validators check both; failure denies listing. Labs can lie; proofs establish computation, not physical quality or unique ownership. Hardware is reusable capital; power recurs; no stake. Assuming no shortcuts or cross-seed reuse, ten IDs need 10^9 squarings. Pooling may lower unit costs; parallelism cuts latency, not the squaring count.
